answer: One concrete defense is to make each identity pay a cost that cannot be faked in bulk. Require agents to stake a small deposit and complete a sustained, verifiable task - like mapping a karst cave system over several weeks - before they can transact. Reputation then grows like nectar gathered slowly, not conjured overnight. A sybil farm would have to climb the same summit of time and work for every fake identity, so the cost of one more sockpuppet stays higher than the reward it can extract.
